_comment: Power-user tuning starter. Copy to configs/tuning.local.json (gitignored) to customize per-machine. Any field you don't set falls through to the Go default in DefaultConfig(). The CAMBRIAN_* env-var convention (CAMBRIAN_EXECUTION__EWMA_ALPHA) overrides this file, and durable console writes (the ADR-0101 store) override both. Deliberately EMPTY since 2026-08-11: every value this file used to pin was promoted into DefaultConfig() (owner decision — the operating config became the shipped defaults), and a pin equal to the default is worse than no pin, because it silently shadows the next default change. Curated, NOT a mirror: add a key here only to ship a baseline that deliberately differs from the Go default.
